modules.title: Carry-on

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: On Aircalin-operated flights and Air France codeshares on international routes: 55 x 35 x 25 cm for a total of 115 cm (pockets, wheels and handles included). Between Noumea and Île des Pins, Lifou, Maré and Ouvea: 45 x 35 x 20 cm.

infant.value: Infants under 2 on Aircalin-operated flights: one piece of cabin baggage of 7 kg and a stroller accepted in the cabin.

carryon_weight.value: Economy on Aircalin-operated flights and Air France codeshares: 1 baggage + 1 accessory, 7kg maximum between Noumea and Auckland, Sydney, Brisbane, Nandi, Wallis and Port-Vila; 12kg maximum between Noumea and Bangkok, Singapore and Papeete, between Bangkok and Paris, and between Noumea and mainland France; 5kg maximum between Noumea and Île des Pins, Lifou, Maré and Ouvea. Business Hibiscus: 12kg maximum between Noumea and Sydney, 18kg maximum (2 baggages + 1 accessory) on the other listed routes. Other routes and partners: see your electronic ticket.

personal_item.value: 1 accessory per person (a laptop computer, one handbag or a duty-free bag), included in the maximum total weight.

modules.lede: Carry-on dimensions and weight are checked at check-in; anything over the limits must be checked in and fees apply. The number of pieces and weight depend on route and cabin.

modules.title: Checked baggage

economy.value: Economy on an Aircalin ticket: between Noumea, Port Vila and Wallis, a total of 23kg; between Noumea and Brisbane, Nadi, Sydney, Papeete, Singapore, Bangkok and Auckland, and between Bangkok and Paris, 1 baggage item of 23kg maximum; between Noumea and France, 1 or 2 items of 23 kg each according to the fare; between Noumea and Isle of Pines, Lifou, Mare and Ouvea, 1 item of 12kg or 20kg according to travel class.

premium_economy.value: Premium Economy: between Noumea and Wallis, a total of 30kg; between Noumea and Brisbane, Nadi, Sydney, Papeete, Singapore, Bangkok and Auckland, and between Bangkok and Paris, 2 items of 23 kg each; between Noumea and France, 1 or 2 items of 23 kg each according to the fare.

business.value: Business Hibiscus: 2 items of 23 kg each between Noumea and Sydney, Papeete, Singapore and Bangkok, and between Bangkok and Paris; 2 items of 32 kg each between Noumea and France.

size.value: Each checked bag: height + width + depth = 158 cm (30 x 70 x 50 cm on domestic flights to Isle of Pines, Lifou, Mare and Ouvea).

infant.value: Babies under 2, all booking classes: one bag up to 10 kg plus a crib, stroller or baby seat (5 kg on Air Calédonie-operated Port Vila flights SB3240 and SB3241).

modules.lede: Your allowance is shown on your e-ticket (for example 1PC, 2PC, or a total weight such as 23); other routes and partner flights follow the e-ticket.

phone_home_market.notes: Aircalin official customer support line in Noumea.
